waypoint's MCP server

Streamable HTTP at /mcp, stateless, answering JSON. Every request takes a bearer token, as the API does, and may send claimed-by: each tool is one API request made with them, so it is refused, recorded and answered as that request would be. A refusal comes back as the tool's error, with the API's status and words. The contract is mcp.json; the API's is here.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "waypoint": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://127.0.0.1:4400/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer wp_…"
      }
    }
  }
}

Instructions

What the server tells an agent when it connects:

waypoint tracks work as epics, stories and tasks. An epic has no parent, every story has an epic, every task has a story. - A parent's status is derived from its open children: move the children, never the parent. - Dependencies are between siblings only. An item moves to in_progress, review or done only once blockedBy is empty. - Close an item (update_item with state closed and a closedReason) rather than delete it. - Say what you did on an item with add_work_log; talk to people about it with add_comment. - Every tool takes an id as the full id or a prefix of at least 8 characters, such as its shortId.

list_items reads only

Items matching every filter given, as GET /items. With no filter, every item, open and closed.

InputTypeRequired
statusbacklog, ready, in_progress, review, done
stateopen, closedopen for only what still needs looking at.
typeepic, story, task
parentstringOnly the children of this item.
heldBystringOnly items held by this name.
tagstringOnly items carrying this tag, by id or value.
queuedbooleantrue: only queued items, in queue order.

get_item reads only

One item, with its derived status, blockedBy and children, as GET /items/{id}.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

create_item

Creates an epic, story or task, as POST /items. A story needs an epic as parent, a task a story; an epic has none.

InputTypeRequired
typeepic, story, task
titlestringyes
bodystring
acceptanceCriteriastring or object[]One per criterion, each a text; they are given ids c1, c2, … in order.
statusbacklog, ready, in_progress, review, doneRead back as given until the item has children. On a parent it is stored but has no effect while the parent has children, done included: a parent reads done by itself once every open child does, so there is nothing to sign off. Never changes a child. in_progress, review or done on a parent still reading backlog or ready is its Start: refused with 409 while its blockedBy, its children's blockers included, is not empty.
parentstring or nullA story for a task, an epic for a story, null only for an epic.
dependsOnstring[]

update_item

Changes the fields given in changes, as PATCH /items/{id}: status, title, body, criteria, parent, dependencies, queued; close it with state closed and a closedReason.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
changesobjectyes
changes.typeepic, story, task
changes.titlestring
changes.bodystring
changes.acceptanceCriteriastring or object[]Every criterion, in order, replacing the list. One given as {id, text} keeps that id, and its tick, under the text given; one given as a text keeps the id of a criterion that already reads exactly that, else gets a new id. An id the item does not have is refused with 400.
changes.metstring[]Every criterion now met, each by its id or its unique text: replaces every tick held, so a tick another writer made since this one read the item is lost. To tick or untick one criterion, use POST or DELETE /items/{id}/met. One already ticked keeps who ticked it and when; one newly named is ticked by this write's claimed-by, now. Each must be one of the item's acceptanceCriteria as this write leaves them, or the write is refused with 400.
changes.statusbacklog, ready, in_progress, review, doneRead back as given until the item has children. On a parent it is stored but has no effect while the parent has children, done included: a parent reads done by itself once every open child does, so there is nothing to sign off. Never changes a child. in_progress, review or done on a parent still reading backlog or ready is its Start: refused with 409 while its blockedBy, its children's blockers included, is not empty.
changes.stateopen, closedClosing closes everything still open beneath the item, for the same reason; reopening opens only the item, keeping its status. Closing an epic that has children as completed is the person's sign-off: refused with 403 from a write that sends claimed-by.
changes.closedReasoncompleted, not_plannedRequired with, and only with, state: closed.
changes.parentstring or null
changes.dependsOnstring[]
changes.reviewedBystring or nullThe worker reviewing the item, as the reviewer's own name; null clears it.
changes.forcetrueMove the item to in_progress, review or done though its blockedBy is not empty, recorded as the history entry's overrode. The person's alone: refused with 403 from a write that sends claimed-by, as every worker's does. Changes nothing on its own.
changes.queuedbooleantrue queues the item to start on its own, at the back of the queue, or keeps its place if already queued; false takes it off. Only an open epic, story or task that reads backlog or ready can be queued, as this write leaves it: any other is refused with 400, naming why. Recorded in history as a change to queuedAt.
changes.tagsanyNot accepted: refused with 400 whatever its value. See WorkItem.tags.

delete_item

Deletes an item no other item names, as DELETE /items/{id}. Prefer closing it.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

item_history reads only

Every write to the item and beneath it, oldest first, as GET /items/{id}/history.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

list_comments reads only

What people and agents said about the item, oldest first, as GET /items/{id}/comments.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

add_comment

Adds a comment to the item, as POST /items/{id}/comments.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
bodystringyesMarkdown.

list_work_log reads only

What was done on the item, oldest first, as GET /items/{id}/work-log.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.

add_work_log

Records what was done on the item, with links to what it made, as POST /items/{id}/work-log.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
bodystringyesMarkdown.
linksstring[]

tick_criterion

Marks one of the item's acceptance criteria met, by its id (c1, c2, …) or its exact text when no other reads the same, as POST /items/{id}/met.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
criterionstringyesThe criterion's id, as c2, or its text when unique.

untick_criterion

Marks one of the item's acceptance criteria not met, by its id or its unique text, as DELETE /items/{id}/met.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
criterionstringyesThe criterion's id, as c2, or its text when unique.

list_tags reads only

Every tag: its value, colour and description, as GET /tags.

No input.

create_tag

Adds a tag to the shared list, as POST /tags.

InputTypeRequired
valuestringyes
colorstringyes
descriptionstringWhat the tag is for, shown when hovering its chip.

update_tag

Changes a tag's value, colour or description, as PATCH /tags/{id}.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe tag's id.
changesobjectyes
changes.valuestring
changes.colorstring
changes.descriptionstringWhat the tag is for, shown when hovering its chip.

tag_item

Puts a tag, by id or value, on the item and everything beneath it, as POST /items/{id}/tags.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
tagstringyes

untag_item

Takes a tag, by id or value, off the item and everything beneath it, as DELETE /items/{id}/tags/{tag}.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
tagstringyes

get_queue reads only

What the queue is running, what waits in it and why, and its running limit, as GET /queue.

No input.

start_item

Asks the configured worker-service for an agent on the item, as POST /items/{id}/assignment; refused when none is configured.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe item's id, or a prefix of it at least 8 characters long, such as its shortId.
